# Programs 10+ departments: Actuarial, Underwriting, Claims, Finance, IT, Risk Engineering, Specialty Lines, and more


*Last updated: October 2026*


Zurich North America is the U.S. arm of the company that insures the world's most complex risks. From skyscraper construction sites to Fortune 500 liability exposure, Zurich's commercial insurance solutions protect the infrastructure of the global economy.[Zurich Insurance Group](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zurich_Insurance_Group) , founded in 1872 in Zurich, Switzerland, has grown into a $69.9 billion global insurance powerhouse (SIX: ZURN) with approximately 65,000 employees serving customers in 215 countries and territories. Zurich North America, headquartered in Schaumburg, Illinois, has operated in the U.S. since 1912 and is one of the largest commercial property and casualty insurers in the country. The company was ranked[#17 for Best Internships for Overall Inclusion by Vault (2026)](https://vault.com/) . Summer 2027 intern applications are[open now](https://www.zurichna.com/careers/interns) : as of October 6, 2026 Zurich's own board lists underwriting internships in nine U.S. cities at $21-$23/hr plus accounting, finance and investment internships.

## What Is a Zurich North America Internship?


A Zurich North America internship is a 10-to-12-week paid summer program placing students into real roles at one of the largest commercial property and casualty insurers in the United States. The[internship page](https://www.zurichna.com/careers/interns) describes the program as offering exposure across 10 or more departments including actuarial, underwriting, claims, finance, IT, risk engineering, and specialty lines. Zurich Insurance Group's global scale (approximately 65,000 employees, $69.9 billion in parent revenue, 215 countries) combined with Zurich NA's U.S.-focused commercial insurance expertise creates an intern experience that bridges local market knowledge with global risk management capability. Vault ranks the program #17 for Best Internships for Overall Inclusion (2026), #29 for LGBTQ+, and #36 for Women.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


From Zurich NA's internship page and Summer 2027 postings:


• **Education:** pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field (actuarial science, math, statistics, business, finance, engineering, or related).


• **Actuarial track:** progress on SOA exams (Exam P or FM) is strongly preferred.


• **Location:** Schaumburg, Illinois (northwest Chicago suburb) for accounting and finance; summer 2027 underwriting internships sit in nine U.S. cities and the investment internships in New York.


• **Insurance interest:** genuine interest in commercial property and casualty insurance is essential.

## What Is the Zurich North America Application and Interview Process Like?


Zurich NA's application process flows through the SAP SuccessFactors-powered careers portal:


1. **Visit the internship page.** Navigate to[zurichna.com/careers/interns](https://www.zurichna.com/careers/interns) for program details and department descriptions.


2. **Search for Summer 2027 intern positions** on the SAP SuccessFactors portal. Filter by 'Intern/Trainee' and U.S. locations. Underwriting, accounting, finance and investment internships are live as of October 2026.


3. **Submit your application** with your resume. For actuarial roles, highlight SOA exam progress and quantitative coursework. For underwriting, emphasize analytical thinking and communication.


4. **Interview.** Expect behavioral and role-specific questions. Actuarial candidates may discuss exam progress and statistical concepts. Underwriting candidates should prepare risk assessment scenarios.


5. **Receive your offer.** Rolling offers; the Vault-ranked program has a structured onboarding experience.


Demonstrate understanding of commercial P&C insurance and Zurich's global scale. Reference the Beazley acquisition and its implications for specialty lines. For actuarial tracks, having passed Exam P or FM is a significant differentiator.

## How Do You Stand Out at the U.S. Arm of a $70B Global Insurer?


Three moves. First, understand the global-to-local dynamic. Zurich Insurance Group operates in 215 countries, but Zurich NA focuses specifically on U.S. commercial P&C insurance. Articulating how global risk management practices inform local underwriting decisions shows strategic thinking. Second, reference the Beazley acquisition. The March 2026 deal for £8.1 billion significantly expanded Zurich's specialty lines in cyber, professional liability, and specialty risk. This is the biggest structural change at Zurich in years, and candidates who understand its implications stand out. Third, for actuarial tracks, demonstrate exam progress. Having passed or studied for Exam P or FM is expected. For underwriting tracks, prepare risk assessment scenarios that show analytical depth beyond classroom theory.

## FAQ


### When should I apply for a Zurich NA Summer 2027 internship?


Apply now. As of October 6, 2026, Zurich's board lists Summer 2027 Underwriting Internships in nine U.S. cities, Accounting and Finance Internships in Schaumburg, and two investment internships in New York. No actuarial internship is posted. Rolling admissions mean early applicants secure positions first.


### How much do Zurich NA interns earn?


Zurich's summer 2027 postings list $21 to $23 per hour for underwriting interns, $22 per hour for accounting and finance interns, $22 to $27 per hour for the alternative investments operations intern, and $64.50 per hour for the senior investment management intern.


### Where are Zurich NA internships located?


Accounting and finance interns sit at the Schaumburg, Illinois headquarters. Summer 2027 underwriting internships are posted in Atlanta, Boston, Dallas, Denver, Houston, Independence OH, Los Angeles, Maitland FL and New York, and the investment internships are in New York.


### What tracks does Zurich NA offer for interns?


Ten or more departments: actuarial, underwriting, claims, finance, IT, risk engineering, specialty lines, and more. The internship page lists department-specific descriptions for each track.


### Is Zurich NA a good company to intern at?


Vault ranks Zurich NA #17 for Best Internships for Overall Inclusion, #29 for LGBTQ+, and #36 for Women. The company is backed by a $70 billion global parent with 65,000 employees and operations in 215 countries.


### What GPA does Zurich NA require?


Zurich's summer 2027 internship postings list a cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above as preferred, and they do not offer visa sponsorship. For actuarial tracks, SOA exam progress on Exam P or FM is a stronger differentiator than GPA alone. Competitive candidates in all tracks likely have 3.0 or above.


### What is the Beazley acquisition?


In March 2026, Zurich Insurance Group acquired Beazley plc for approximately 8.1 billion pounds. This adds specialty lines expertise in cyber insurance, professional liability, and specialty risk. The acquisition may create new intern tracks in these specialty areas.


### How long is the Zurich NA internship?


The program runs 10 to 12 weeks during the summer. The internship page confirms paid summer programs across 10 or more departments with real project assignments and exposure to global insurance operations.
